=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:269-272; .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 269-272; _shell_segments_with_operators, lines 269-272; _push_targets, lines 541-550 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The parser removes a numeric argument immediately before a redirection, so a numeric branch refspec can go unchecked while the guard checks the current branch instead.
  WHY: A push to a merged branch named `2` may be permitted after the guard checks an unrelated branch; DeepSeek rates this BLOCKER while OpenAI rates it MAJOR.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 1402-1403; .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 1399-1403; lines 1402-1403 `_warn(target.warning)` | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Warning-bearing push targets for unresolved options or destinations only emit a warning instead of requiring confirmation.
  WHY: The guard may check an unrelated current branch and allow a push to an unchecked merged destination without asking.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 1407-1409 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `continue` for warning-bearing fallback targets skips merged-PR evaluation of the fallback target.
  WHY: A push to an already-merged branch can avoid the exit-code-2 block and proceed if the confirmation is approved or unavailable.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 1421-1423; .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py and workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 1421-1423; lines 1422-1423 `_warn("could not resolve git push source; checking the session checkout instead")` + `target = _GuardTarget(checkout, {}, "", "HEAD", True)` | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: When a push source cannot be resolved, the guard checks the session checkout’s `HEAD` instead of requiring confirmation.
  WHY: The checkout may be unrelated to the push, leaving the actual destination branch’s merged-PR status unchecked.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 270-278 and 723-737 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: With environment assignments before a file-descriptor redirection, the parser retains the descriptor digit and fails to detect the guarded `git` command.
  WHY: `git_subcommands` returns no guarded subcommands, causing `_evaluate_bash` to return without checking or prompting for the push or commit.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 270-278 and 551-579 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash]
  PROBLEM: Trailing file-descriptor redirections on `git push` are parsed as extra arguments and produce a warning-bearing fallback target.
  WHY: Routine pushes to safe, unmerged branches can trigger a confirmation prompt for an unverified destination.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 90-93 and 937-940 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The leading-redirection test parameter lists omit `"2>&1 git push origin HEAD:feature/x"`.
  WHY: The test suite does not check detection or blocking for that leading redirection, allowing a regression in guarded-command detection to go unnoticed.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py, line 919 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The `test_push_parser_guards_real_destination` parameter list still contains `"git push origin 2>/dev/null"` despite the intended test change.
  WHY: The reviewers report that the case conflicts with the updated ambiguous-numeric-redirection behavior and can make the expected destination lookup assertion fail.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 269-276; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 269-272 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root guard’s ambiguous-numeric-redirection branch treats `2` and `<ambiguous-io-number>` as separate refspecs, while the template guard still uses the old unconditional pop.
  WHY: The reviewers report this can cause duplicate destination lookups and makes the two guard copies diverge.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 266-268 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: Leading `2>&1` redirection handling leaves the redirected-to descriptor `1` before `git`, so the guarded command is not detected.
  WHY: `git_subcommands` sees `1` rather than `git` at the start of the segment and the push can bypass the merged-PR guard.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py vs workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, root lines 269-276 vs template lines 269-272 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root and template guard copies differ in their numeric-redirection parsing.
  WHY: Consumer repositories can receive different push-parsing behavior, and the reported parity test would fail.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "A numeric push argument immediately before a redirection is checked as a possible branch and also requires confirmation when safe, since shell tokenization cannot distinguish `2 >out` from `2>out`."
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:_shell_segments_with_operators; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: Both guard copies are reported to lack the intended ambiguous-I/O-number handling; the root `_evaluate_bash` is reported to still use `_warn(target.warning)` rather than requiring confirmation for the unresolved target.
- requirement: "An unresolved push source also requires confirmation instead of checking the session checkout's unrelated HEAD."
  expected_change_site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:_evaluate_bash; workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: Both files are reported to retain `_warn("could not resolve git push source; checking the session checkout instead")` followed by `target = _GuardTarget(checkout, {}, "", "HEAD", True)`.
- requirement: Add `"2>&1 git push origin HEAD:feature/x"` to the parametrize lists of `test_leading_redirection_preserves_guarded_command` and `test_leading_redirection_still_blocks_merged_branch`.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The lists at lines 90-93 and 937-940 are reported not to contain `"2>&1 git push origin HEAD:feature/x"`.
- requirement: Remove `"git push origin 2>/dev/null"` from `test_push_parser_guards_real_destination`.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: Line 919 is reported to still contain `"git push origin 2>/dev/null"` in the parameter list.
- requirement: Add regression tests `test_numeric_refspec_before_redirection_still_checks_merged_branch`, `test_ambiguous_numeric_redirect_asks_if_branch_is_safe`, and `test_unresolved_push_source_asks_without_checkout_lookup`.
  expected_change_site: tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The reviewer reports no matches for `test_numeric_refspec`, `test_ambiguous_numeric`, or `test_unresolved_push_source`.
- requirement: Add the documentation paragraphs describing numeric push arguments immediately before redirections and confirmation when safe.
  expected_change_site: README.md:1238-1239; agents.md:635-636; changelog.d/6187-isolated-codex-agents.md
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: README.md:1238-1239 and agents.md:635-636 are reported to end without the numeric-argument paragraph; changelog.d/6187-isolated-codex-agents.md is reported to lack the “Ambiguous numeric redirections” sentence.
- requirement: Root and template guards must remain byte-identical.
  expected_change_site: workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: The root guard is reported to have the `if len(segment) == 1: segment.pop() else: segment.append("<ambiguous-io-number>")` branch at lines 270-275, while the template guard at lines 270-271 still has the old unconditional `segment.pop()`.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 269-272 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Unconditional `segment.pop()` strips a numeric token that may be a legitimate branch refspec, so a push to that merged branch may not be checked.
  WHY: `_push_targets` can receive no refspec and return empty targets, so the guard does not block the push on the merged branch.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 1402-1403 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_warn(target.warning)` for an unresolvable refspec or push option does not require confirmation.
  WHY: An uncertain push can proceed after only a warning instead of routing the verdict to confirmation.
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 1421-1423 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: An unresolvable push source falls back to checking the session checkout’s `HEAD`.
  WHY: The checkout may be a different repository from the push target, so the guard can check unrelated PR history.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py, lines 90-93 and 937-940 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The leading-redirection parameter lists omit `"2>&1 git push origin HEAD:feature/x"`.
  WHY: The test suite will not catch a regression that stops detecting or blocking that redirected push.
- tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py, line 919 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `"git push origin 2>/dev/null"` remains in the parameter list after the intended test change.
  WHY: The reviewer reports the case can conflict with the updated parser behavior and expected lookup assertion.
